title: "Enter times manually" offered from all three picker entry points
preconditions: Signed in as a test student enrolled in an NYU class-search course with no saved section; NYU class search mocked to return sections
steps: Open the class page and click "Set your section"
Close the picker; open "Your classes" and open the section picker for the same class
Close it; open the subjects dialog, add an unenrolled course so it appears under "To add", and open its section picker
expected: In all three places the picker opens and shows an "Enter times manually" option alongside the NYU section list

title: Manual option shown in NYU error and "no sections" states
preconditions: Signed in as a test student; NYU class search mocked to (a) fail with a network/server error, then (b) return zero sections
steps: With the NYU mock failing, open "Set your section" on the class page
Observe the error state
Switch the mock to return zero sections and reopen the picker
Observe the "no sections" state and click "Enter times manually"
expected: Both the error state and the "no sections" state show an "Enter times manually" option; clicking it opens the manual form

title: Single meeting with multiple days, start and end time
preconditions: Manual form open for a class
steps: Toggle day chips Tue and Thu
Set start time 14:00 and end time 15:15
Leave term dates empty
expected: Chips Mon–Sun are all available; Tue and Thu show as selected; times accept the values; Save becomes enabled (term dates are optional)

title: Add and remove meetings, maximum of 5
preconditions: Manual form open with one valid meeting
steps: Click "Add meeting" until 5 meetings are shown
Try to add a 6th meeting
Remove meeting 3
Check that "Add meeting" is available again
expected: Up to 5 meetings can be added; the add control is disabled/hidden at 5 so no 6th appears; removing one leaves 4 with the other meetings' values intact and adding is possible again

title: Multiple meetings with different times saved together
preconditions: Manual form open for a class
steps: Meeting 1: Mon, Wed 09:30–10:45
Add meeting 2: Fri 13:00–14:00
Set first day 2026-09-02 and last day 2026-12-15
Save
expected: Save succeeds; saved label shows "Your times · " followed by both meetings (Mon, Wed 9:30–10:45 am and Fri 1:00–2:00 pm), label ≤ 200 chars

title: Validation: meeting with no day selected
preconditions: Manual form open
steps: Set start 14:00 and end 15:15 without selecting any day
Then select Tue
expected: An error next to the day chips says at least one day is required and Save is disabled; after selecting Tue the error clears and Save is enabled

title: Validation: end time not after start time
preconditions: Manual form open, Tue selected
steps: Set start 15:00 and end 14:00
Set end equal to start (15:00)
Set end 16:00
expected: For end before start and end equal to start, an error appears next to the end time and Save is disabled; with end 16:00 the error clears and Save is enabled

title: Validation: last day before first day; error in one of several meetings
preconditions: Manual form open with one valid meeting
steps: Set first day 2026-12-10 and last day 2026-12-01
Fix last day to 2026-12-10 (same day)
Add a 2nd meeting and leave its days empty
expected: Last-before-first shows an error next to the last-day field and Save is disabled; same day is accepted; the empty 2nd meeting shows its own error and keeps Save disabled until fixed

title: Save manual times and label shown everywhere
preconditions: Test student enrolled in a class with no saved section
steps: Open "Set your section" → "Enter times manually"
Tue, Thu 14:00–15:15, Save
Check the class page header button, "Your classes", and the home Next lecture card
Reload the page
expected: Saved without error; every place shows "Your times · Tue, Thu 2:00–3:15 pm" (or equivalent); persists after reload; stored row in class_sections has section_no 'Manual', schedule_type 'MANUAL', meetings [{day:1,start:840,end:915},{day:3,start:840,end:915}]; no new migration file in supabase/migrations

title: Manual times replace an existing NYU section
preconditions: Test student has an NYU section saved for the class (mocked NYU data)
steps: Open the picker for the class and choose "Enter times manually"
Enter Mon 10:00–11:00 and Save
Inspect the label and stored schedule
expected: Only one schedule exists for that student and class; the NYU section is replaced; label shows "Your times · Mon 10:00–11:00 am"; other students' schedules are unaffected

title: Countdown within 24 h from manual times (fixed now, New York time)
preconditions: Manual times Tue, Thu 14:00–15:15 saved, no term dates; clock faked to Thu 2026-12-03 10:00 America/New_York (browser timezone set to a non-NY zone, e.g. UTC, to prove NY time is used)
steps: Open the home page
Read the Next lecture card
expected: Card shows this class with a countdown of about 4 h (starts at 2:00 pm today New York time), identical in format to an NYU section countdown

title: Happening now and day + time beyond 24 h
preconditions: Manual times Tue, Thu 14:00–15:15 saved; clock faked in America/New_York
steps: Set now to Thu 2026-12-03 14:30 and open home
Set now to Fri 2026-12-04 10:00 and open home
expected: At 14:30 Thu the card shows the class as happening now; at Fri 10:00 the card shows the next lecture as Tue 2:00 pm (day + time, no countdown)

title: Term dates respected by the countdown
preconditions: Manual times Tue, Thu 14:00–15:15; clock faked in America/New_York
steps: Save first day 2027-01-20 (Wed); set now to Tue 2027-01-05 10:00 and open home
Change to last day 2026-12-15 (Tue), no first day; set now to Wed 2026-12-16 10:00 and open home
Set now to Tue 2026-12-15 10:00 and open home
expected: Before term: next lecture is Thu Jan 21 2:00 pm (not Jan 5/7); after the last day: no upcoming lecture for this class is shown; on the last day itself: countdown about 4 h

title: Reopen picker shows pre-filled manual form and edit saves
preconditions: Manual times saved: Mon, Wed 09:30–10:45 and Fri 13:00–14:00, first day 2026-09-02, last day 2026-12-15
steps: Click the class header button "Your times · …"
Check the form values
Change Fri meeting end to 14:30 and Save
expected: Picker opens directly on the manual form with both meetings, days, times and term dates pre-filled; after save the label shows Fri 1:00–2:30 pm

title: Switch from manual times back to an NYU section
preconditions: Manual times saved for an NYU class-search course; NYU search mocked with sections
steps: Reopen the picker (manual form shown)
Choose the option to pick an NYU section and select a section
Check label, stored row and home card
expected: The NYU section replaces the manual times (one schedule only, schedule_type no longer MANUAL); label shows the NYU section; home countdown uses the NYU meetings

title: Clear manual times
preconditions: Manual times saved for a class
steps: Reopen the picker
Use Clear
Check labels and home card
expected: Schedule removed for that student and class; class page shows "Set your section" again; class no longer contributes to the Next lecture card

title: Manual times set under "To add" are saved after Done
preconditions: Test student; subjects dialog open; a course not yet enrolled
steps: Add the course so it appears under "To add"
Open its section picker → "Enter times manually", enter Tue, Thu 14:00–15:15, Save
Check the "To add" row label before Done
Click Done; open "Your classes" and the class page
expected: The "To add" row shows "Your times · Tue, Thu 2:00–3:15 pm" before Done; nothing is saved before Done; after Done the class is enrolled and the manual schedule is saved and shown in "Your classes", the class page and the home card

title: Removing a course from "To add" discards its manual times
preconditions: Subjects dialog open with a course under "To add" that has manual times set
steps: Remove the course from "To add"
Click Done
expected: Course is not enrolled and no class_sections row is created for it; no error

title: Keyboard-only and screen-reader use of the manual form
preconditions: Manual form reachable from the class page
steps: Using only Tab/Shift+Tab/Enter/Space, open the picker, choose "Enter times manually", toggle Tue and Thu, enter times, add and remove a meeting, Save
Inspect the accessibility tree (role/name/state) for day chips, time and date inputs, and error messages
expected: All actions possible by keyboard with visible focus; day chips are buttons exposing aria-pressed true/false that changes on toggle and have day names; time/date inputs have accessible labels (e.g. "Start time, meeting 1"); errors are associated with their fields (e.g. aria-describedby / aria-invalid)

title: 390 px width, light and dark theme
preconditions: Viewport 390×844; manual form with 5 meetings and term dates filled
steps: Open the manual form in light theme and scroll through it
Check document scrollWidth equals viewport width
Switch to dark theme and repeat; also check labels in "Your classes" and the home card
expected: No horizontal scroll; chips wrap; inputs and buttons fit; text and chip selected/unselected states readable with sufficient contrast in both themes; long "Your times · …" labels truncate or wrap without overflow

title: Regression: NYU section picking, countdown and subjects dialog
preconditions: Test student; NYU search mocked with sections; clock faked Thu 2026-12-03 10:00 America/New_York
steps: Pick an NYU section for a class from the class page and from "To add" in the subjects dialog; finish with Done
Check the section label and home Next lecture card
Add and remove a course in the subjects dialog without setting any section
expected: NYU section picking, labels and countdown behave as before this change; subjects dialog add/remove/Done works unchanged

title: Typecheck, unit tests and build pass
preconditions: Branch claude/manual-class-times checked out, dependencies installed
steps: Run bun run typecheck

Run the unit tests and confirm tests exist for manual schedule → meetings conversion (e.g. Tue, Thu 14:00–15:15 → [{day:1,start:840,end:915},{day:3,start:840,end:915}]) and validation (no day, end ≤ start, last < first, >5 meetings)
Run bun run build
expected: All three commands exit 0; conversion and validation unit tests are present and pass
